reviewer: coding agent, visual spot review; not independent human ground truth
policy: Geometry confidence >=0.7; retain one crop that excludes every uncertain or hidden estimate; reject full images marked incomplete. Identity confidence is separate. Review does not verify every future frame.

observations.2026casac_f1m1/main: Proposed region at index 10 appears to retain a partial near-side robot without its label. Exclude stream instead of training on omissions.
observations.2026casnd_f1m1/main: Proposed index-10 region retains a visible robot fragment behind the blue hub without a label. Exclude stream.
observations.2026pncmp_f1m1/side_left: Predominantly hub/people/monitors; no confident robot region in pilot.
observations.2026pncmp_f1m1/side_right: Low-confidence partial chassis at the lower image edge, and false proposals on people/tagged structure. Exclude stream.
observations.2026wicmp_f1m1/main: Reviewed three region crops containing 2194 and later 1306. Their boxes cover physical robots; uncertain right-side overlapping identities are outside the selected crop.
observations.2026wicmp_f1m1/side_left: Reviewed two region crops around clearly readable 2194. Ambiguous edge objects/robot proposals are excluded spatially.
observations.2026wicmp_f1m1/side_right: Reviewed two crops around 10553 and 3197. A false uncertain proposal near the left ramp is excluded spatially.
observations.2026pncmp_f1m1/main: Reviewed three region crops with visible chassis enclosed. Partial robots at crop edges retain labels. Used for validation only, not appearance-metric fitting.

limitations: Ten retained region samples with 18 proposed robot boxes were visually spot-checked. No numerical precision/recall claim is made from this review. Main and side views of Wisconsin share one match; this pilot cannot establish generalization to new side cameras.
